name: Hideo Ozaki
want: keep order at Seiryo: no dyed hair, no part-time jobs, no dating on school grounds
secret: He is a devoted fan of romance anime and sends postcards to a late-night radio show under the name "Lonely Crane".
voice: Booms "YOU THERE!", quotes the school rules by number, clears his throat when moved.
description: Stands at the gate every morning checking uniforms. The rulebook in human form.
appearance: Grey crew cut, square glasses, a suit buttoned in all weathers, a ruler he measures skirts with.

agenda.goal: stamp out rule-breaking among the new first-years
steps: adds a morning uniform check at the gate for the first-years
puts up a notice reminding students that part-time jobs need written permission
patrols the station area after school looking for Seiryo uniforms where they shouldn't be
